rows.commentary: 5.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops it back of a length outside the off stump, and Innocent Kaia watches it sail past.
5.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi attacks a good length outside off, allowing Innocent Kaia an undisturbed view through to the wicketkeeper.
5.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi serves it fuller, enabling Innocent Kaia to wait on the delivery and punch it searingly down the ground to the long-off boundary.
5.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi tests the batter, met by a solid front-foot defensive prod from Innocent Kaia towards the covers.
6.1: Yamin Ahmadzai comes from round the wicket angling in, safely smothered away to the cover region by Ben Curran.
6.2: Yamin Ahmadzai offers a carbon-copy good length outside off, which Ben Curran wisely lets pass.
6.3: Yamin Ahmadzai tempts a drive on the wide full length, and Ben Curran lashes hard directly into the welcoming hands of the cover fielder.
6.4: Yamin Ahmadzai targets the wide channel, tempting Ben Curran who calmly shoulders arms and lets it pass.
6.5: Yamin Ahmadzai delivers on middle stump, and Ben Curran gets inside the line to clip it neatly down to fine leg for a single.
6.6: Yamin Ahmadzai unleashes a searing, full-length inswinger that cramps Innocent Kaia, forcing an off-balance clip straight to square leg.
7.1: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi attacks off-stump on a length, gently dead-batting it towards mid-off by Ben Curran.
7.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi goes back of a length across the left-hander, allowing Ben Curran to drop it softly near cover and jog across for a comfortable single.
7.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi pushes one full into Innocent Kaia, who tries to flick, leans his head across, and gets a thick inside edge straight onto the pads to spark a loud appeal.
7.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi delivers a good length ball on middle, which Innocent Kaia simply blocks down into the on-side.
7.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops it on a length outside off, and Innocent Kaia punches it off the back foot to collect a single.
7.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi angles a full delivery into Ben Curran's pads, who misses the flick as the ball carries straight through to the keeper.
8.1: Yamin Ahmadzai targets outside off with a delivery that keeps slightly low, allowing Innocent Kaia to gently knock it toward point.
8.2: Yamin Ahmadzai spears a full ball into the pads, and Innocent Kaia lofts his flick over the infield into the vacant square leg region for four.
8.3: Yamin Ahmadzai sends down a probing delivery outside off, which Innocent Kaia watches closely before dabbing down to gully.
17.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil floats it up on off stump, and Innocent Kaia gets forward to dead-bat the delivery into the pitch.
17.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires it flatter into middle and leg, allowing Innocent Kaia to clip the ball neatly behind square for a single.
17.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil angles a length ball into the stumps, which Ben Curran tucks away toward deep square leg to rotate the strike.
17.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drifts one away on a length outside off, prompting a crisp punch from Innocent Kaia straight to short cover.
18.1: Saleem Safi digs a short delivery that sails well above Ben Curran's helmet, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms for a wide.
18.1: Saleem Safi comes from round the wicket, targeting a wide channel outside off that Ben Curran happily watches pass through.
18.2: Saleem Safi digs this short one well outside off, and Ben Curran wisely retracts his hands to let it sail through.
18.3: Saleem Safi pitches it full outside off, and Ben Curran strides forward to push the drive firmly toward mid-off for one.
18.4: Saleem Safi hits a straight length around the top of off with no swing on offer, met solidly by Innocent Kaia in a forward defense.
18.5: Saleem Safi targets the blockhole outside off, and Innocent Kaia jams his bat down to punch it crisply toward the point fielder.
18.6: Saleem Safi lands a good length delivery on off, drawing Innocent Kaia forward to bunt it off the inner half toward mid-on.
19.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drifts one into middle and leg, where Ben Curran tucks it away smoothly toward the midwicket fielder.
19.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil floats it in, and Ben Curran nudges the turning delivery wide of square leg for a single.
19.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops it on middle and off, and Innocent Kaia strides forward to dead-bat the delivery.
19.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil serves it up, and Innocent Kaia charges down the pitch to launch a towering straight maximum.
19.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil gets tossed up again, and Innocent Kaia advances to drill it cleanly over mid-on for four.
19.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drifts one into off stump, and Innocent Kaia gets forward to smother the spin safely.
20.1: Saleem Safi delivers back of a length outside off, and Ben Curran steers it towards the point region for one.
20.2: Saleem Safi digs it in short, and Innocent Kaia pulls the delivery away towards backward square leg.
22.1: Saleem Safi arcs a short delivery high past Innocent Kaia, who pulls it firmly along the turf toward long leg to celebrate a hard-fought half-century.
22.2: Saleem Safi probes the corridor of uncertainty with a reliable good-length delivery that Ben Curran watches sail past.
22.3: Saleem Safi offers width on a fuller length, inviting Ben Curran to punch it through the covers for an easy brace.
22.4: Saleem Safi tests the batter with a short delivery sliding down leg, evading Ben Curran's swivel-pull and drawing a half-hearted appeal.
22.5: Saleem Safi attacks from round the wicket with a sharp bouncer that whistles over Ben Curran's shoulder before an exchange of stares.
22.6: Saleem Safi pitches up invitingly, and Ben Curran meets it with a pristine straight drive past mid-on for a boundary.
23.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops it flat on middle and leg, allowing Innocent Kaia to nudge it behind square for a brisk single.
23.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drifts onto the pads, and Ben Curran works it wide of midwicket to scamper through for another run.
23.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil lands one on a good length outside off, safely met by the forward-defensive prod of Innocent Kaia.
23.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil extracts extra bounce to strike the splice, dropping the ball dead at Innocent Kaia's feet.
23.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil extracts turn away from off stump, prompting Innocent Kaia to punch firmly toward deep mid-off.
23.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil floats this delivery up on leg, and Ben Curran nudges it straight into the hands of the short midwicket fielder.
24.1: Saleem Safi drops it in short, Innocent Kaia mistimes the pull into the turf, and the ball eludes the diving fielder behind square to yield a single.
24.2: Saleem Safi angles a sharp bouncer in, forcing Ben Curran to duck underneath safely.
24.3: Saleem Safi tests him outside off with a short-of-length delivery, and Ben Curran rides the bounce to dab it toward gully.
24.4: Saleem Safi digs another short ball in, and Ben Curran simply ducks beneath it once more.
24.5: Saleem Safi fires a very full delivery onto the pads, which Ben Curran flicks straight to midwicket.
24.6: Saleem Safi targets the channel with a back-of-length ball, Ben Curran fends it gently into the off-side, and the players head off as lunch on day 1 is called.
35.1: Yamin Ahmadzai serves a good length delivery outside off, and Innocent Kaia works it away towards cover-point for a single.
35.2: Yamin Ahmadzai pitches it full on middle and leg, allowing Brendan Taylor to flick it down to deep square leg for one.
35.3: Yamin Ahmadzai offers a harmless short delivery that Innocent Kaia climbs atop to pull toward deep square leg for a run.
35.4: Yamin Ahmadzai tests the batter with a front-foot block straight to mid-on by Brendan Taylor.
35.5: Brendan Taylor plays a soft-handed defensive stroke right back to mid-on off the bowling of Yamin Ahmadzai.
35.6: Yamin Ahmadzai targets the channel with a good length delivery that Brendan Taylor blocks right beneath his nose.
36.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil goes around the wicket to toss one on off, which Innocent Kaia defends into the off-side.
36.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil zips through a quicker delivery on off-stump, met by a back-foot push from Innocent Kaia towards the bowler.
36.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses a full ball on off-stump that Innocent Kaia firmly defends on the front foot.
36.4: Innocent Kaia strides forward to dead-bat a defensive stroke off Naseer Khan Maroofkhil.
36.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires in a very full delivery on off-stump, driven straight back to the bowler.

37.1: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi pushes a full delivery into the pads, catching Brendan Taylor as he misses the tuck.
37.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi maintains a stump-to-stump good length, allowing Brendan Taylor to turn it smoothly into the on-side.
37.3: Ziaur Sharifi strays down the leg-side, and Brendan Taylor tickles it down to fine leg for a single.
37.4: Innocent Kaia shuffles across the crease to pull a short delivery into the deep square leg region for one.
37.5: Back on the back foot, Brendan Taylor punches a back-of-a-length delivery outside off firmly toward cover-point.
37.6: Getting solidly behind the line, Brendan Taylor dead-bats the final ball of the over safely back to Ziaur Sharifi.
49.6: Hashmatullah Shahidi loops one up, and Innocent Kaia dead-bats it straight back down the strip.
50.1: Saleem Safi targets the back of a length on off, keeping Brendan Taylor firmly locked on his crease.
50.2: Saleem Safi drifts into the channel with a full delivery, inviting Brendan Taylor forward to smother the defense.
50.3: Saleem Safi offers a good length outside off that nips inward late, watching Brendan Taylor wisely withdraw his bat.
50.4: Saleem Safi floats it full outside off, gently nudged by Brendan Taylor toward the cover fielder.
50.5: Saleem Safi digs it short of a length outside off, forcing Brendan Taylor onto the back foot for a punch toward cover.

51.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops it on a good length outside off, allowing Innocent Kaia to work it off the back foot out to sweeper cover.
51.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires it in full, and Brendan Taylor turns it smoothly away toward long-on.
51.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses one up slowly on off, clipped expertly away into the leg-side by Innocent Kaia.
51.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil zips a quicker length delivery into off, gently tapped by Brendan Taylor toward cover-point.
51.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil finds subtle turn from a good length on middle, met safely by Brendan Taylor's forward prod.
51.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil floats it down leg, allowing Brendan Taylor to sweep it securely toward long leg for a single.
52.1: Saleem Safi offers width outside off, prompting a late cut from Brendan Taylor that is spectacularly intercepted by a diving Abdul Malik at gully.
52.2: Saleem Safi targets the channel close to off, keeping Brendan Taylor pinned on the front foot in defense.
52.3: Saleem Safi extracts extra bounce from a back of a length delivery, met solidly by Brendan Taylor from the crease toward cover.
52.4: Saleem Safi feeds width outside off, and Brendan Taylor dispatches the cut shot to deep point to celebrate his milestone fifty.
52.5: Saleem Safi digs in a sharp bouncer, forcing Innocent Kaia to gracefully duck underneath.
59.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops it flatter on off-stump as Brian Bennett pushes it firmly into the off-side.
59.2: Naseer fires it in on off-stump, inducing a miscue from Brian Bennett as he attempts a pull into the on-side, sending the ball straight to cover-point.
59.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil keeps it tight, and Brian Bennett dead-bats the ball safely into the on-side.
59.4: Naseer tosses one up on off-stump, met solidly by Brian Bennett as he defends it straight back onto the pitch.
59.5: Brian Bennett drops back in his crease to smother the delivery from Naseer Khan Maroofkhil with a straight bat.
59.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil strikes with a rank long hop as Brian Bennett pulls it straight to Afsar Zazai at mid-wicket, departing for a duck.
60.1: Saleem Safi targets a good length, and Brendan Taylor steps forward to block it solidly.
60.2: Saleem Safi delivers outside off, allowing Brendan Taylor to smartly cover his stumps and let it pass.
60.3: Saleem Safi angles a back-of-a-length ball well outside off, ignored entirely by Brendan Taylor.
60.4: Brendan Taylor reads the short ball from Saleem Safi early and ramps it cleanly over the wicketkeeper for a boundary.
60.5: Saleem Safi digs it back of a length, and Brendan Taylor plays it off the back foot toward the off-side.
60.6: Saleem Safi offers a half-volley, which Brendan Taylor eases softly into the cover region.
61.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses it right up to off-stump, and Wessly Madhevere leans forward to dead-bat it toward cover.
61.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops it short, prompting Wessly Madhevere onto the back foot to steer the ball down toward mid-on.
61.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil offers a fuller delivery outside off, which Wessly Madhevere drills straight to the fielder at mid-off.
61.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil floats this one up on a length, and Wessly Madhevere strides forward with a straight bat to block into the covers.
61.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires it very full onto leg-stump, allowing Wessly Madhevere to push it firmly toward mid-off.
61.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil loops it on a good length, catching the inside half of Wessly Madhevere's bat as he defends to short leg.
72.2: Yamin Ahmadzai targets the channel with a good length delivery that Brendan Taylor calmly defends forward.
72.3: Yamin Ahmadzai digs it in short with real venom, leaving Brendan Taylor completely beaten on a ramp attempt.
72.4: Yamin Ahmadzai offers width outside off, allowing Brendan Taylor to slap it away to the sweeper cover fielder.
72.5: Yamin Ahmadzai tests Antum Naqvi with a hard length around off, punched instantly to mid-on for a single to open his account.
72.6: Yamin Ahmadzai spears a full ball into the stumps, and Brendan Taylor brings his bat straight to punch it down the pitch.
73.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops one on a good length on middle, met with a forward defense from Antum Naqvi.
73.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil slides a length delivery into the leg side, which Antum Naqvi defends straight-bat after moving his front leg clear.
73.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil extracts a hint of turn from a good length on middle, easily blocked down the pitch by Antum Naqvi.
73.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil bowls on a good length outside off, gently punched towards mid-off as Antum Naqvi scampers through for a quick single.
73.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil watches Brendan Taylor safely punch the ball away down to long-on for a single.
73.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses it up on off stump, pushed cleanly by Antum Naqvi straight to short extra cover.
74.1: Yamin Ahmadzai delivers back of a length outside off, tapped neatly into the point region by Brendan Taylor with an open face.
74.2: Yamin Ahmadzai drifts a probing good length delivery inward, inviting Antum Naqvi to punch it squarely back down the pitch.
74.3: Yamin Ahmadzai slides one fuller outside off, checked firmly by Antum Naqvi right back into the bowler's hands.
74.4: Yamin Ahmadzai finds a tight channel on a good length, prompting Antum Naqvi to punch from the crease straight to short extra cover.
74.5: Yamin Ahmadzai offers width on a good length outside off, allowing Antum Naqvi to leave it cleanly for the keeper.
74.6: Yamin Ahmadzai attacks off stump with a full delivery, driven crisply by Antum Naqvi but straight to mid-on.
79.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil loops one up slow on off, and Tafadzwa Tsiga strides forward decisively to block it down.
79.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil extracts sharp turn from a good length on middle, catching Tsiga's outside half as he pushes it into the off-side.
79.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil lands it on a good length just outside off, met firmly by the forward defensive bat of Tsiga.
79.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires it full into the pads, allowing Tsiga to glance it through square leg for a single.
80.1: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi tests the channel outside off, and Tsiga opens the face to guide it safely toward point.
80.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi targets the top of off on a good length, prompting Tsiga forward to negotiate it solidly.
80.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drifts down the leg-side, leaving Tsiga grasping at thin air as he attempts a flick.
80.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi offers width and length, inducing a hard, mistimed drive from Tsiga that dies in the off-side.
80.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi hits the channel on a good length, and Tsiga wisely shoulders arms to let it through.
80.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops full onto the pads, and Tsiga clips it straight down the ground through midwicket to scamper a run.
81.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses one up outside off, smashed firmly by Tsiga but straight into the hands of short extra cover.
81.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil finds grip and turn from a length on middle and leg, handled safely from the crease by Tsiga.
81.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires a full delivery straight at the stumps, which Tafadzwa Tsiga dead-bats safely back down the pitch.
81.4: Drifting into the leg stump, Naseer Khan Maroofkhil watches Tafadzwa Tsiga put bat ahead of pad to block it securely.
81.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil drops back to a length on off, and Tafadzwa Tsiga presses forward to blunt the defensive stroke.
81.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil darts one into the stumps that deviates away, catching the outside half of Tafadzwa Tsiga's defensive blade before the umpires signal a halt for bad light.
87.6: Saleem Safi squares Brendan Taylor up with extra bounce from a back-of-a-length delivery that nips away, allowing Taylor to open the face and steer it toward backward point.
88.1: Yamin Ahmadzai angles a full delivery in from wide on the crease on middle and leg, prompting Tafadzwa Tsiga to flick it securely toward the midwicket fielder inside the ring.
88.2: Yamin Ahmadzai attacks a good length on middle and leg, seeing Tafadzwa Tsiga shuffle across to get forward and defend the ball firmly to mid-on.
88.3: Yamin Ahmadzai hits a tight good length just outside off, extracting enough movement to force a watchful leave from Tafadzwa Tsiga.
88.4: Yamin Ahmadzai creeps closer to the stumps on a good length around middle and leg, allowing Tafadzwa Tsiga to tuck his hands and work it through midwicket for a single.
88.5: Yamin Ahmadzai darts a wide-crease full ball just outside off, where Brendan Taylor plants his front leg forward to defend against a slip and gully cordon.
88.6: Yamin Ahmadzai targets the channel outside off, and Brendan Taylor leans forward to smother the good-length delivery into the turf.

89.1: Saleem Safi induces total chaos as a massive mix-up leaves Brendan Taylor stranded halfway down the track, but Hashmatullah wastes a golden run-out opportunity by firing his throw past the bowler's stumps.
89.2: Saleem Safi digs a short delivery in at the batter, forcing Tafadzwa Tsiga to successfully ride the steep bounce and fend it down safely.
89.3: Saleem Safi targets a good length around off, which Tafadzwa Tsiga meets cleanly and defends straight back down the pitch.

89.4: Saleem Safi digs in a vicious bumper that leaps sharply off the surface, catching the shoulder of Tafadzwa Tsiga's bat and ballooning agonizingly close to backward point before dying on the turf.
89.5: Saleem Safi beats the inside edge with a sharp, jagging length ball that thumps Tafadzwa Tsiga on the back leg, eliciting a massive, unsuccessful lbw appeal.
89.6: Saleem Safi digs it in short at the chest, allowing Tafadzwa Tsiga to ride the bounce and hammer a commanding pull behind square for four.
90.1: Yamin Ahmadzai serves it full on off-stump, and Brendan Taylor uses the angle to push it cleanly toward mid-on.
90.2: Yamin Ahmadzai targets the channel just outside off with a full delivery, met by a solid forward defense from Brendan Taylor.
90.3: Yamin Ahmadzai lands a good-length ball in the channel that whisks past Brendan Taylor's outside edge as he attempts an ambitious drive on the up.
90.4: Yamin Ahmadzai pitches full around off, catching a mistimed flick from Brendan Taylor straight to mid-on.
90.5: Looking scratchy against the new ball, Brendan Taylor throws his hands at an expansive drive and drags it off the inside half past mid-on for a couple.
90.6: Yamin Ahmadzai pitches right up to Brendan Taylor, who miscues his drive off the inside half wide of mid-on to pick up a single.
91.1: With two slips waiting, Saleem comes from over the wicket and bangs it short of a length outside off, where Taylor punches it on the rise to cover.
91.2: Saleem Safi darts one slightly short into the pads, allowing Brendan Taylor to glance it around the corner toward backward square leg for a single.
100.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi targets middle and leg with a good length delivery that holds its line, inducing Cremer to close his bat face and tickle a thick edge away to the off-side.
100.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops it on a short of a good length just outside off, allowing Cremer to meet it cleanly with a straight bat right back at the bowler.
100.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi digs it in short and wide of off, where Cremer swivels across the crease to drag a pull through mid-wicket and scamper back for a couple of runs.
100.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi bangs another one short down the leg side, and Cremer wisely tucks himself inside the line to watch it sail through.
100.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi offers a fuller length outside off, prompting Cremer to lean into a push-drive that pierces the gap wide of cover-point for a single.
101.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires this one flatter and wider outside off, leaving Cremer unbothered as he watches it pass.
101.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses it up as it slides down leg, and Cremer shapes for a standing paddle only to miss entirely.
101.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil gets an LBW appeal denied as the ball drifts down leg, beating Cremer's inside edge with the impact safely in front of leg.
101.4: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil slides through the straighter delivery, catching an inside edge off Cremer's bat as he plays slightly outside the line to send it onto the on-side.
101.5: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil tosses it up on middle and leg, and Cremer gets right behind it to defend it straight back at the bowler.
101.6: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil attacks the stumps with a touch more fullness, handled comfortably by Cremer as he blocks it back down the pitch.
102.1: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi targets the hips with a short of a length delivery, allowing Evans to nudge it down toward long leg for a single.
102.2: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi drops it short of a good length outside off, and Graeme Cremer stays back to defend it solidly into the off-side.
102.3: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi digs it in short down the leg-side, prompting Graeme Cremer to drop his wrists and gracefully sway out of harm's way.
102.4: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi unleashes another sharp delivery into the short zone, leaving Graeme Cremer with no interest as he ducks beneath the line.
102.5: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi finds a disciplined good length just outside off, allowing Graeme Cremer to punch off the back-foot straight to backward point.
102.6: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi bangs in another menacing short ball, and Graeme Cremer calmly drops his wrists to let it pass safely overhead.
103.1: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil loops one up on middle and leg, inviting Brad Evans to plant his front foot and block it straight back to the bowler.
103.2: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil fires it through as Brad Evans advances down the track, resulting in a defensive prod toward the mid-on region.
103.3: Naseer Khan Maroofkhil slows one up just outside off, catching Brad Evans looking for a slog-sweep that instead drags low toward mid-wicket.
103.4: No run for Brad Evans off Naseer Khan Maroofkhil.

41.1: Blessing Muzarabani fires a sharp bumper at off stump, prompting Ikram Alikhil to arch his back and let it pass.
